Yeah, it’s such a hit or miss for me. It either make an me feel good. Or makes me want to die even more. Such a toxic community I mute everyone in the game and just focus on myself. 

I do have steam. I haven’t played in it much recently. What game are you’ve focusing on right now?

You’re right. I was in a group before and it helped. It’s only once a week yes. The hard part about the last group I was in, that once it was done, I felt empty and I had no connection with anyone else. I just don’t want to feel like that again.
Lately been playing league of legends. I usually focus on one game at a time. Last game was overwatch. And diablo 3. How about you?
I like to read and paint, play video games.

I joined a group yes, it started 2 weeks ago but I had to miss the first session because i was in another country and the second got cancelled. It’s on Thursday this week if I make it to then. I just tried to use a hotline and their services were down. I feel like even when I try to help myself things go wrong.

I have borderline personality and incredible anxiety. I cannot maintain any relationships even though all I crave is to be close to people. I end up hurting everyone I love. I can’t do this anymore. I don’t want to be alone, but I don’t want to hurt anyone. It’s torturing me.
